name: hazel_weir_synchronous_velocity_graph
description: Procedural Execution Graph featuring synchronous 18-20 plot land-labor expansion, in-situ harvest-and-water execution, duration-gated Town Shop arbitrage, calibrated capital velocity without early cash starvation, and a Day-23 perennial Strawberry compounding cutoff.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Audits net available cash, shed capacity, midnight payroll liability, active town shop order deadlines against crop growth cycles, and oracle competitor dump signals.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Enforces dynamic payroll reserve locks starting at Hour 17 and executes emergency liquidation of uncommitted surplus before Hour 21 to prevent workforce bankruptcy cascades.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills lucrative 2.0x-3.5x town shop contracts while strictly enforcing growth-duration feasibility gating on seed purchases to prevent dead capital in unmaturable slow crops.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Monitors competitor dump projections and executes rapid front-run liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) before market prices crash.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Executes batch liquidations of uncommitted surplus at calibrated price floors (>=0.80x base) to maintain continuous cash velocity for reinvestment without early-game starvation or panic dumps.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Drives synchronous workforce and land expansion up to 10-11 hands and 18-20 plots by Day 15, accelerating hyper-fertilized Strawberry compounding with a Day-23 perennial cutoff.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Directs hands using in-situ plot servicing (harvest then immediately water in-situ) to eliminate plot dry pauses and minimize round-trip transit latency.

attributes.guidance: Lock payroll reserves immediately. Freeze discretionary seed, tool, and land purchases. Schedule worker harvest deposits before hour 20. If net cash remains below midnight payroll by hour 20, execute emergency sales of uncommitted shed inventory at market price to guarantee 100% payroll solvency.
attributes.pitfalls: Never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery. Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (0 if n_animals == 0 else max(3, n_animals * 3)). Never delay emergency liquidations past hour 21.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.3 + 120.0 and has_feasible_shop_contract)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Deliver matching shed inventory immediately to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium. Strictly gate seed procurement: only purchase seeds for active shop demands if (current_day + crop_growth_days <= contract_deadline_day) and current_day <= 24. Cap single-harvest shop plots to at most 2-3 plots concurrently to safeguard core Strawberry acreage.
attributes.pitfalls: Never purchase seeds for slow single-harvest crops (Pumpkins, Tomatoes) if growth time exceeds contract deadline. Never hold uncontracted surplus speculatively for unrevealed contracts. Bypass contracts requiring unmaturable crops.

attributes.condition: oracle_glut_risk >= 0.50 and current_price >= 0.78 * base_price and uncontracted_surplus_inventory >= 4
attributes.guidance: Preempt confirmed competitor dumping by executing rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (>= 0.78 * base_price) before opponent volume collapses market pricing.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not trigger on minor forecast variance (keep glut threshold >= 0.50). Never front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts. Never dump into already collapsed markets (< 0.65 * base_price) prior to Day 29.

attributes.condition: (day <= 7 and uncontracted_surplus_inventory >= 6) or (day > 7 and uncontracted_surplus_inventory >= 8) or shed_used >= 30 or day >= 29
attributes.guidance: Execute batch sales of uncommitted inventory when current price >= 0.80 * base_price. If shed occupancy reaches >= 50%, relax price floor to 0.75 * base_price to maintain fluid cash velocity. On Days 29-30, execute terminal liquidation of all remaining marketable inventory regardless of price floor.
attributes.pitfalls: Never dump at destructive 0.60x panic floors prior to Day 29. Do not raise surplus batch size above 10 items as it chokes early-game cash velocity. Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock reserve (0 if n_animals == 0 else max(3, n_animals * 3)).

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.4 + 90.0 and (hired_hands < 11 or uncultivated_plots > 0 or total_plots < 20 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 27
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce to 10-11 hands synchronously with contiguous land: 8-10 plots at 3-4 hands (Days 3-6), 14-16 plots at 6-7 hands (Days 7-11), and 18-20 plots at 8-11 hands (Days 12-16). Transition 100% of core acreage to hyper-fertilized Strawberries by Day 6. Maintain persistent fertilizer coverage. For uncultivated plots between Day 24 and Day 27, plant rapid 3-day Carrots. Cease all seed purchases after Day 27.
attributes.pitfalls: Never expand land beyond 20 plots or after Day 16. Do not plant new Strawberries after Day 23. Never plant slow single-harvest crops unless tied to a feasible active town shop contract. Strictly cease all seed buying and planting after Day 27.

attributes.guidance: Direct hands via in-situ plot servicing: 1) Harvest ripe plot, 2) Immediately water that exact plot in-situ before moving (zero transit cost, eliminating dry-interval regrowth delays), 3) Service adjacent plots until worker bag reaches capacity (3-4 items), 4) Route directly to shed for deposit, 5) Take fertilizer/seeds on shed departure only when traveling toward unserviced plots. Feed livestock and weed/till secondary to watering. On Days 28-30, focus 100% of worker actions on watering and harvesting mature crops. Ensure all carried inventory is deposited before step 716.
attributes.pitfalls: Never leave a harvested plot unwatered when standing on it. Never allow single-crop worker transit cycles. Never till or plant seeds after Day 27. Ensure no worker holds carried inventory past step 716.
